advanced.line: Sign-in page, home address, method, headers, certificate
placeholder.name: Like Home or Work
tag.optional.name: {name}, optional
note.home: On Wi-⁠Fi, Octo uses it when it answers, and the main address otherwise.
description.headers: Sent with every request to this server, such as an access token for a proxy in front of it.
note.apiKeyInTheOpen: Not encrypted, and your API key travels as it is. Anyone on the way can read it.
method.helper.Token: Works with most servers. Your password goes as a one-time token.
method.helper.LegacyPassword: Only for older servers that reject the normal sign-in.
method.helper.ApiKey: For servers that give out API keys.
method.helper.ApiKey.known: Your server gives out API keys.
error.unreachable: Couldn't reach the server. Check the address, and that you're on the right network.
error.restarting: The server isn't answering right now. It may be restarting, so try again in a moment.
error.notMusic: That address answered, but not like a music server. Check the port.
error.wayRefused: The server doesn't take this way of signing in.
error.badAddress: That doesn't look like a server address.
error.badHomeAddress: The home network address doesn't look like a server address.
error.missingSecret: Enter the password or key to sign in this way.
error.gone: That server isn't in your list any more.
error.alreadyKept: {name} is already in your list with that address and username.
legacy.hint: This account can't sign in with a token. Choose Legacy password under Advanced, Signing in.
legacy.unsafe: This server needs the password sent as it is, which isn't safe over http. Use https, or choose Legacy password under Advanced, Signing in.
cert.title: Client certificate
cert.password.title: Certificate password
cert.password.hint: The password the certificate file was saved with.
cert.asked: This server asks for a client certificate. Choose one under Advanced, Special setups.
cert.refused: The server didn't accept that client certificate.
cert.keyKind: Octo can't play through this kind of key. Use an RSA (2048 bits or more), P-256, P-384 or Ed25519 certificate.
cert.wrongPassword: That password doesn't open this certificate file.
cert.notAFile: This isn't a certificate file Octo can open. Choose a .p12 or .pfx file.
cert.noKey: This file has no private key, so it can't sign in. Choose the file with your key.
cert.notForClients: This certificate is only for servers, so it can't sign in.
cert.expired: This certificate has expired. Choose a current one.
cert.notYetValid: This certificate isn't valid yet. Check this computer's date, or choose another.
cert.tooBig: This file is too big to be a certificate.
link.whileBusy: That link came in while Octo was signing in. Open it again to use it.
link.forAnotherAccount: This link is for another account. Add it from Add a server.
link.forAnotherServer: This link is for another server. Add it from Add a server.
link.codeElsewhere: This code can't sign in here. Use it from Add a server instead.
link.afterAddressChange: The address here was changed. Add this link from Add a server instead.
link.whileSignInOpen: Finish or close the sign-in that's open, then try this link again.
link.askWhileSignInOpen: Sign in to {name} when you're done here.
trust.title: Trust this certificate?
trust.changed.title: The server's certificate changed
trust.refused: Not connected. The server's certificate wasn't trusted.
trust.detail: This {device} doesn't trust the certificate the server showed. If it's your own server's, check the fingerprint matches before you trust it. Octo trusts it for this host only, and keeps trusting it when it's renewed with the same key.
trust.changed.detail: This host showed a different certificate from the one you trusted. Servers renew their certificates, so this is often expected, but check the fingerprint matches your server's before you trust it. Until then Octo can't reach the server.
inGroup.Authentik.false: Authentik is in front of this server, so Octo needs its own sign-in to get through. Fill in the fields above.
inGroup.Authentik.true: Authentik didn't accept that username and app password.
inGroup.Authelia.false: Authelia is in front of this server, so Octo needs its own sign-in to get through. Fill in the fields above.
inGroup.Authelia.true: Authelia didn't accept that username and password.
inGroup.CloudflareAccess.false: Cloudflare Access is in front of this server, so Octo needs a service token to get through. Fill in the fields above.
inGroup.CloudflareAccess.true: Cloudflare Access didn't accept the service token. Check that a Service Auth rule allows it.
inGroup.PasswordPrompt.false: This server asks for a username and password before Octo can reach it. Fill in the fields above.
inGroup.PasswordPrompt.true: The server's password prompt didn't accept that username and password.
inGroup.SignInPage.false: A sign-in page answered instead of the server. On public Wi-⁠Fi, sign in to the Wi-⁠Fi first. Otherwise fill in the fields above.
inGroup.SignInPage.true: The sign-in page in front of the server didn't accept those details.
